terms.grammar: verb phrase: ērigō, ērigere, ērēxī, ērēctum, with animum
evidence: Cic. Clu. 58: ērigēbat animum jam dēmissum et oppressum Oppiānicus (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: “Raise the spirit”: the image is of lifting what has sunk (animus dēmissus).

sources: Lewis & Short: erigo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 22–23, checked against the searchable text of the book.
